name: Yakima River Canyon
blurb: Basalt-walled desert canyon between Ellensburg and Yakima — family rafting, blue-ribbon trout, raptors overhead.

sections.notes: Easy current through the canyon. BLM charges a $5 day-use fee ($15 overnight) at its Yakima River Canyon recreation sites, which are open year-round (https://www.blm.gov/visit/yakima-river-canyon-campgrounds).

putInAccess.accessType: Launch (open gravel/sand clearing to the water)
putInAccess.operator: Bureau of Land Management (Wenatchee Field Office)
putInAccess.sourceName: Access: BLM Yakima River Canyon page (lists Bighorn among BLM's five developed river access sites). Coordinate: North's own Google Maps marking, checked on Esri World Imagery
putInAccess.note: IMAGERY-PLACED: coordinate placed from satellite imagery and confirmed by North's own circled marking and Google Maps coordinate (46.8939898, -120.5004652), checked on Esri World Imagery z19 (z20 not available), 2026-10-25. Agency published no exact launch coordinate: BLM's National Recreation Site Points layer has no Bighorn feature. On imagery (research/raw/batch4/bhN.png, bhN_w.png, bh19c_g.png) the point sits inside an open gravel/sand clearing that runs from a small paved pull-off and structure beside SR 821 down to the Yakima's north-east shore. The clearing's water-side tip is about 8.5 m SSW (~46.89392, -120.50051). The point is not in the water, not on the road and not in the paved lot (the lot edge is ~15 m NE). Offsets: 426 m SE of the earlier v1/AW candidate (46.8965, -120.5047, an opening near the campground's NW end, now superseded); ~130 m SE of the Google 'Bighorn Boat Ramp' label pin. Our georeference of North's screenshot (Esri features + scale bar) gave a water end within ~9 m of this point. Legal access: BLM's Yakima River Canyon page (https://www.blm.gov/visit/yakima-river-canyon-campgrounds) lists it among BLM's five developed river access sites (Bighorn, Umtanum, Lmuma Creek, Big Pines, Roza), open year-round; fees $5 day-use, $15 overnight. Spot-check first: no ramp surface is visible (natural launch), and the imagery date is unknown.
putInAccess.bankSourceName: USGS NHDPlus HR flowline (flow-direction digitized) + Esri World Imagery
putInAccess.bankNote: Facing downstream (NHDPlus HR flow bearing ~128, SE through the canyon), the launch is on the north-east bank, left of the NHD centreline (~41 m; ftype 558 artificial path). On imagery SR 821 runs along the same (left) bank and the railway along the opposite (right, south-west) bank.

sections.notes: Roza is the last take-out — half a mile above Roza Dam. Do not continue. Motorboats are allowed below the Roza launch. BLM charges a $5 day-use fee ($15 overnight) at its Yakima River Canyon recreation sites, which are open year-round (https://www.blm.gov/visit/yakima-river-canyon-campgrounds). Take out at Roza; Roza Dam is downstream.
